events.content:
Built a small Next.js reading journal. The home page shows separate **Currently reading** and **Finished** shelves. You can add a book with notes, mark it finished, and open a detail page with a shareable link.

Books are saved to `data/books.json` when you add the first one; the file stays on disk after a restart and is ignored by Git. Run the app with `npm run dev`.

The main pages are [the reading shelf](/workspace/app/page.jsx), [the add-book form](/workspace/app/add/page.jsx), and [the book detail page](/workspace/app/books/%5Bid%5D/page.jsx). The JSON storage logic is in [lib/books.js](/workspace/lib/books.js).

`npm run build` completed successfully.

item.text:
Built a small Next.js reading journal. The home page shows separate **Currently reading** and **Finished** shelves. You can add a book with notes, mark it finished, and open a detail page with a shareable link.

Books are saved to `data/books.json` when you add the first one; the file stays on disk after a restart and is ignored by Git. Run the app with `npm run dev`.

The main pages are [the reading shelf](/workspace/app/page.jsx), [the add-book form](/workspace/app/add/page.jsx), and [the book detail page](/workspace/app/books/%5Bid%5D/page.jsx). The JSON storage logic is in [lib/books.js](/workspace/lib/books.js).

`npm run build` completed successfully.
